notes.title: Feature Update 0.8.14
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40156767/461a037c252c517790a7a01c34504d84faf4cb6c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40156767/8da72f0146d5601f548fae4ffaf537e8aa07ff79.png[/img][/url]
It's been a while! We've been working to get back to this game and we're finally back.

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]All enemies now spawn a scan popup that allows you to take a closer look and maybe get a hint or two on how best to fight them
[*]The main menu Options now includes a section for setting screen resolution and windowed mode
[*]You can now hold shift, press a button on your gamepad, or touch the boost bar to boost your ship forwards
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The music in the main menu will no longer explode your ears the first time you play the game. It will reflect your music volume settings from the main game.
[*] Misc. small issues
[/list]

We're excited to be back! As we get back into the groove, hopefully these updates will come more regularly. Thanks to anyone who's still watching the game!

notes.title: Bugfix Patch 0.8.13
notes.notes:
In preparation for the release of the Military Hauler, this patch will fix a few of the remaining issues with the Military ships.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where black hole would destroy bullets instead of sucking them in (animation still yet to come)
[*] Fixed issue where bullets would sometimes fail to register when hitting the compound shield of a military ship
[*] Fixed issues with drone behavior when delivering ores to the player
[/list]

More to come soon! The Hauler is close to complete and will release in the next few days.

notes.title: Feature Release 0.8.9 - Gamepad and Touchscreen Support
notes.notes:
This patch is a general feature update that adds support for multiple input sources and does a few minor bug fixes.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added gamepad support
[*] Added touchscreen support
[*] Added support for large tablets with or without peripherals attached
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where new resource wouldn't show up in synopsis
[*] Fixed issue where game could get stuck in the synopsis
[/list]

notes.title: Levels 41-44 Almost Complete - Chapter 3 Update
notes.notes:
Work is moving forward, and we're poised to release the next set of levels. The AI is basically complete and we're now in testing for the new levels.

[b]Required Features - Military Chapter[/b]
[list]
[*] Mark Two Drones (complete)
[*] Mark Two Upgrades (complete)
[*] Drone Ship AI (complete)
[*] Miner AI (complete)
[*] Hauler AI (complete)
[*] Guardian AI
[*] Military Bosses
[/list]

After the military levels start coming, everything will move quickly.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.8
notes.notes: We found an additional issue with how explosions are handled and made a quick fix. This affected the first boss fight if the game was running at an extremely high framerate.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.6
notes.notes:
The recent boss update contained a few bugs that were identified after release. Those are now fixed:

[list]
[*] Boss warp out animation had a short glitch
[*] Fixed individual segments still not showing up properly in synopsis in levels 35-39
[*] Fixed issue where repeating the second boss after death could lead to a game lock
[*] Fixed various graphical glitches
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.8.5 Released
notes.notes:
The Pirate Boss has been completed! With this, we're moving forward into the next major set of levels (41-59) and the next update should be up in a week or two. With that said, here are the new features and fixes:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where segments of the Pirate Boss didn't properly display in the level synopsis
[*] Fixed sound playback issues
[*] Slightly altered balance to make the pirate boss and pirate faction more enjoyable to fight
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Pirate boss fight
[*] Combat area can now expand and shrink
[*] New global commands that can be applied to individual levels
[*] Small optimizations for particle handling
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon[/b]
[list]
[*] Shop expansion
[*] New weapon for Chapter 3
[*] Mark 2 Drones
[*] Military Faction first wave enemies
[/list]
